title: state_subscribe
description: A device on the hub path (parental controls or the effective rule control_path hub) asks for live states while the hub is reachable (with a key it reads Home Assistant itself away from home). Answer state_subscribed, then one entity_state with the current state of every visible entity (tap targets included), then entity_state for every change of an entity visible to the device (until the connection closes; send again after client_config_updated). When a weather entity is visible, sun.sun is relayed too (day and night of the weather; read only, never controllable). Other devices get control_error {not_hub_controlled}.
